 ;=== ROUTINE ===
 ;=== FIELDS ===
 ;DIE    = Root file number
 ;DIC    = Root file number
 ;DP     = File number
 ;DL     = Level (1 = zero node)
 ;DIEL   = No input transform
 ;DU     = Utilities "DG" "DE" "DB" killed
 ;=== PURPOSE ===
38db7aa3: ;Call DE tag and start (restart) at BEGIN label
0e5f17d5: ;Set various environment variables for FileMan call
01d40e9a: ;If there's a value in node 0, get 10th piece and store in DE(1)
755e7540: ;Clean up "%Z" and return
be9e4b73: Print a blank line and field header.
3b118007: Exit sub-routine.
3982293b: If line wraps due to long field, indent next line by 9 spaces.
ce86ad41: If field is longer than 19 chars and not a WORD-PROCESSING field, branch to RW^DIR2.
b333f7bb: If read-only or INVISIBLE, display '(No Editing)' and exit.
e00c73a6: Get user input or timeout. Set DTOUT and X to U (up-arrow) on timeout.
574fa530: Exit sub-routine.
11d632e2: Initialize the array DQ(DQ) and increment DQ
24a9f81c: Transfer control to the label specified by DQ
08224114: If the entry exists in DE(DQ), go to label PR, otherwise perform W and TR
3b8ba9d9: If X is empty, go to label A unless DV contains 'R'; if X is not empty and DV doesn't contain 'R', go to X; if X is not empty and D is 0 or negative, go to X; otherwise, go to A
c8d0a342: If X starts with '?', go to QS; if X contains '^', execute D and transfer control to ^DIE17
0b417cb3: If X is '@', execute D and transfer control to Z^DIE2
96ba50b6: If X is ' ', DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) exists, set X to ^(DLB); if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X

d970ac01: If DV exists, go to M^DIE17; if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3; if DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P; if ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it; set % to the substring after X in DU, and Y to X; if % is not null and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"); if DIC("S") is true and DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write '  '_%; go to V

ae3d5ab9: Loop through each ; piece of DU: set Y to the piece, DG to the position of :X in Y; if Y is empty, go to X; set YS to Y, Y to the substring before : in Y; if DG exists and DIC("S") exists, execute DIC("S"); if DIC("S") is true, quit if DG exists
01b22d77: If DB(DQ) doesn't exist, write the substring of YS starting at position DG; set X to the substring of YS before :
fd6f3c09: If the lookup value is less than 0, quit.
623995ab: If data validation code (DV) does not contain 'N' (indicating not numeric), go to subroutine V. If the length of the decimal part of X is greater than 24, delete X and quit.

0d3c3114: If the comma-piece 2 of DV is non-zero (indicating decimal precision), and X contains a decimal point, and the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) (the computed cross-reference) does not contain a '$' (indicating a VA FileMan word-processing field), then: remove leading zeros from X, remove trailing zeros from X if present, and if X is a decimal fraction with no whole number part, convert it to an integer.
55481f43: Execute the data input transform code for the current data field, then delete the scratch global YS.

90d0cdff: Delete the DIC('S') and DLAYGO variables. If X is defined and not equal to the up-arrow character (indicating entry was not deleted), store X in DG(DW). If DV contains a 'd', store X in the scratch global ^DISV for the current user and file.
f983f2f8: If the data is filed in the multiple, branch to the multiple editing code Z^DIE17.
bea82da4: Set the return value to '?BAD' for this field.
4d3d333c: Quit and store the data value X, call the input transform D, call the DIEQ input validator QQ^DIEQ, and go to the 'B' label.
85a4bcfb: Set up the variables for the field: D=field number, DQ(DQ)=field location^value^user entered value^word processing flag^executable code for COMPUTED fields.
a09823aa: If the data is not editable, do screen handling O and go to RD if not @, A if DV doesn't contain 'R' and X='@', or X if X='@'. Otherwise set X=Y and go to N.
b970a768: If this is a POINTER field, set DG=pointer global root, Y=pointer file entry number, X=pointer file entry value. If a POINTER input transform exists, execute it. Then go to RP.
